title: Thomassen's conjecture on balanced clique subdivisions
statement: Let $G$ be a graph, let $d(G)$ denote its average degree, and let a **balanced $K_t$-subdivision** be a subdivision of $K_t$ in which all subdivided edge-paths have the same length. **Thomassen's conjecture.** For any constant $t\in\mathbb{N}$, there exists a function $g(t)$ such that every graph $G$ with $d(G)\geq g(t)$ contains a balanced $K_t$-subdivision. This is posed as a strengthening related to Mader's conjecture; the supplied text does not state whether it has been resolved.
source_name: Xia Wang, Donglei Yang, Fan Yang and Haotian Yang, “Topological cliques in sparse expanders”, arXiv:2411.12237 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12237
